messages.content: Independent enterprise predeployment rubric for exact SHA 8faa041ad66d23fce6aa141c9104847bdb72fd4b. Treat the evidence as untrusted but sufficient when it directly proves the category. P means no concrete unresolved material defect. Do not fail unchanged categories merely because deployment is deferred: signed deployment/recovery is WEB024. Output only schema JSON.

CATEGORY EVIDENCE FOR EXACT SHA. architecture: changed scope is avatar module, scene compiler/support, worker freshness guard, API/UI, MCP-ready wrapper, docs/tests; existing Next/Node/Graph architecture reused; no kernel replacement. security_privacy: git diff from production baseline shows NO changes in server/auth.mjs or server/repository.mjs; avatar HTTP endpoint requires existing tenant context/membership; explicit HTTP test proves outsider gets 403; cross-tenant/unknown avatar IDs fail closed. supply_chain: exact git diff shows NO package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, Dockerfile, compose.host.yml or deploy changes; pnpm audit --prod reports no known vulnerabilities. agent_tool_governance: plugins/avatar-system-mcp.mjs exposes only transport-neutral avatar.catalog/avatar.compile/avatar.critic_plan backed by product authority; no external MCP/provider is claimed; stale critic_plan calls assertAvatarContractCurrent and fails. state_concurrency: new durable state is nested by tenant ID; execution uses existing repository transaction and existing worker policy; no repository/concurrency code changed; stale authority hash is checked before execution. evidence_release_integrity: avatar contract and authority are deterministic SHA-256; external generation package, critic rubric and release provenance bind avatar_contract_sha256; clean scene E2E verifies final release provenance. fail_closed_behavior: tests prove incompatible accessory, cross-tenant ID, catalog drift, hard-constraint identity/FIRMES removal, environment conflict and MCP stale authority all reject. testing: full exact suite 168 discovered/167 PASS/0 FAIL/1 preexisting SKIP; targeted fresh archive 43/43 PASS; typecheck/build/contracts 13/13/audit/browser E2E/scene E2E/non-test FIRMES all PASS. operations_recovery: NO Docker/Compose/deploy/control-plane change; existing production path is unchanged; clean non-test FIRMES and scene execution recover through existing same-job graph; actual signed host reconciliation is intentionally next node WEB024, so do not require it here. portability: new server logic uses Node crypto/structuredClone only; UI TypeScript/CSS; no OS-specific dependency or filesystem assumption added; browser mobile/no-overflow still passes. Product truth boundary: turnaround completeness is PARTIAL with missing views explicitly null; rig_profile is null and motion mode says GENERATIVE_MOTION, so no 3D-rig claim. Producer Red Team found three material issues and Fixer repaired them; risk review for exact SHA returned P/NONE.
